results.title: Generate - definition of generate by The Free Dictionary
results.content: 1. to bring into existence; originate; produce: to generate ideas. 2. to create by a natural or chemical process: to generate heat. 3. to be a source or cause of; inspire: to generate enthusiasm. 4. to reproduce; procreate.

results.title: Generate Definition & Meaning | Britannica Dictionary
results.content: GENERATE meaning: 1 : to produce (something) or cause (something) to be produced; 2 : to be the cause of or reason for (something, such as interest or excitement)

results.title: GENERATE Definition & Meaning | Dictionary.com
results.content: A spirit possessed of any conscious individuality whatever must generate a certain interior force to maintain it.

results.title: generate - WordReference.com Dictionary of English
results.content: gen • er •ate /ˈdʒɛnəˌreɪt/ v. [~ + object], -at•ed, -at•ing. to bring into existence; produce; originate: to generate ideas. to create by a natural or chemical process: They used the waterfalls to generate power. to inspire: to generate enthusiasm. See -gen-.

results.title: Generate Definition & Meaning | YourDictionary
results.content: To originate or produce by a physical, chemical, mechanical, electronic, or mathematical process. To generate electricity, software that generates graphs.
